beats.say: This is Rendr. It records and edits video in one place, and it is driven entirely by an agent over M C P.
This video is the proof. No screen was recorded, no mouse was moved, and no timeline was touched by hand.
A headless browser drives the page, and the pointer path is authored by the script rather than captured from hardware.
Rendr draws that cursor, and cuts every punch in from the same path, so the zoom always lands on what was clicked.
It has a hundred and one tools for editing, and this whole clip came from one storyboard file.
The voice is Kokoro running locally. No API key, nothing leaves the laptop, and the subtitles are timed from the same words.
